notes.title: Patch 3
notes.content:
-Added persistent settings including: player's color, ball's color, volume settings and display settings
-Songs are now synced between players online
-Camera tweaks mainly to keep players in view better when the ball is high up in the air
-Fixed a preloading bug causing various issues while starting up
-Fixed an issue with the ball trail displaying incorrect colors
-Fixed an issue leading to blood/paint sometimes being rendered over the curtains
-Fixed an issue allowing you to slide and/or fast fall after being kicked

notes.title: Patch 2
notes.content:
Build 1.0.2 Notes

-Added blood/paint when someone gets kicked
-Added hit markers when the ball gets kicked
-Fixed an issue leading to crown/hats being broken
-Fixed an issue leading to players not seeing the correct color of the ball trail when it is kicked by the other person
-Fixed an issue leading to difficulties connecting to server while joining
-Worked on player's hit box, giving them a more defined shape
-Worked on lag compensation
-Added a hat

We are continuously working on Average Human Ball Game and plan on bringing much more to it. Stay Tuned!

notes.title: Patch 1
notes.content:
With Average Human Ball Game coming out of Early Access just a few days ago, we would like to thank everyone who has given this game a chance. We have so much more planned for this game and will be releasing content updates as regularly as possible so stay tuned!

Patch 1 has released fixing a few minor issues, changing one of your moves and adding a hat!

Patch Notes: 
-Fixed issue where starting the game with certain buttons would make you're character unable to move
-Fixed issue where the peer wouldn't see the rotation of the ball properly
-Fixed some issues with the hat causing it to "break" and become immovable 
-Changed the "Crouching Block" animation to be more useful
-Added a new hat


Stay tuned for the next update! We have some new content in the works.

notes.title: Post Patch 1
notes.content:
Post Patch 1

Known issues

-As the peer, you see the host and ball slightly delayed, causing you to have to predict a bit. We have improved on the issue in this patch, but there does seem to still be a delay for some users, apparently lessened. We will continue to work on this.
-You are stuck with what ever name you have the first (online) game you enter, you must restart the entire game to change it. Local games are not affected by this. We have identified the issue and will be working on it
-GPU/CPU usage, it's higher than it should be and we have identified various causes. We will continue to work on this.
-NO JOYSTICK, it's crazy I know, this will definitely be in the next (or maybe the next, next) update.
-No way to "Type" with the controller, we will be working on this.
-It is possible to break the game with the levers if someone is "Readying Up" at the same time as the other person is "Un-Readying Up"

-and there's plenty more we plan on fixing before we continue to really expand on the game

notes.title: Patch 1
notes.content:
Change/Fix Log
-Games restart smoother and faster now (visual and speed improvements)
-Online games should perform better, with less of a time difference between host and peer
-Fixed various "Lounge" computer issues
-Fixed "Game Code" issue where a comma would appear in the "Game Code" and make it unusable
-Fixed music only playing one song on loop. 
-Levers in the "Lounge" now have a delay before they can be triggered again
-Fixed an issue where the host would be able to start the game before the peer at times
-Fixed an issue where restarting could cause the peer to desync
-Fixed various issues where the players would not be positioned properly and face the wrong directions at times during start and on goals
-Fixed an issue where joining back into an existing lobby would sometimes create a new lobby instead
-Fixed various issues where players would remain invincible through rounds, goals, and from the "Lounge"
-Fixed an issue where the ball could get stuck on top of the "Backboard"
-and quite a few more small changes
